scope: 2023 English Uprising v23-10-12, standard 2–4-player multiplayer including required two-player Rival, optional standard CHOAM; no solo, Rival variants, six-player teams or cross-game expansions. Relevant official FAQ January 13 2025 clarifications included.

verdict.coverage: One explicitly unrequested source-defined availability branch merits one stable question. Broad Q17/Q46 definitions could imply the answer, but their actual requested conditions do not test the distinguishing state.
verdict.key: Two complete expected strings need explicit versioned availability qualifications; originals remain untouched. Their all-taken statements are sufficient cases printed on p16, not individually false rulings, but incomplete as exhaustive definitions against p20 and the original Leader.
verdict.candidate_other_human: 2 Solari from bank; no reserved contract. Unacquired reserved contracts do not block this fallback.
verdict.no_predetermined_result: Addition, key qualification and Shaddam assessments were derived from the supplied primary sources and actual prompts after the complete reads.

source_reconciliation.legal_availability_versus_ownership: A token can remain unowned yet be unavailable to a given player. The original Leader makes the Sardaukar reserve exclusively acquirable by Shaddam; the FAQ expressly denies initial possession. Therefore not all taken is compatible with none available to another human.

apparently_differing_printed_formulation.phrase: If all contracts have been taken by players
apparently_differing_printed_formulation.meaning: Sufficient ordinary exhaustion case; no printed only-if or wait-until-all-owned restriction.

apparently_differing_printed_formulation.phrase: take a face-up contract (or, if there are none left, gain 2 Solari)
apparently_differing_printed_formulation.meaning: Operational availability fallback. For the other human the public face-up options are empty and the reserved tokens cannot legally be selected.
Consistent with the icon-guide availability reading; neither space grants access to another player's exclusive reserve.

source_reconciliation.resolution: Use the complete printed rules together: p16 states the usual exhausted-pool case, p20 gives the operational no-contract-left fallback, and the Leader limits legal acquisition. There is no need to invent an exception that makes another human wait while Shaddam's unowned reserve persists.
source_reconciliation.not_done: No source is declared misprinted, no unofficial later/digital rule is substituted, and no six-player rule supplies the standard Leader ability.

direct_source_support.statement: Set aside both Sardaukar contracts; only Shaddam can acquire them during the game.
He starts without possession and has the option to acquire a reserved contract in place of a generally available one.

shaddam_own_empty_public_assessment.straightforward_deduction: The natural operational reading is that his remaining reserved contracts are still personally acquirable at an ordinary contract-taking opportunity: the Leader does not print a prerequisite that a public offer must still exist. The general public exhaustion does not transfer his reserve to others. This is an inference from the Leader plus the FAQ option, not a directly printed empty-public example.
shaddam_own_empty_public_assessment.uncertainty: Neither the Leader nor FAQ expressly discusses a contract icon received by Shaddam after the public offers are empty. The FAQ describes substitution in place of a generally available contract, while p20 describes the no-face-up fallback. These do not directly settle whether he may elect 2 Solari while a reserved contract remains, or impose any special mandatory choice in that exact state. Do not claim direct source confirmation of those refinements.
do_not_invent: Do not assert public exhaustion forbids Shaddam from acquiring a reserved contract; that adds an unstated public-offer prerequisite.
Do not assert reserved tokens automatically become possessed, generally available, or payable as Solari merely because public offers vanish.
Do not create a special Shaddam-only fallback or an unconditional forced 2-Solari ruling from the word generally.
shaddam_own_empty_public_assessment.benchmark_recommendation: No additional hard-key question about Shaddam's own empty-public choice. Retain the directly printed option in Q43/Q102 and keep the proposed new question explicitly about a different human.

genuine_additions.complete_expected_ruling: The other human gains 2 Solari from the bank and takes no contract. They cannot acquire Shaddam's set-aside Sardaukar contract; only Shaddam can acquire those reserved contracts. The public supply has no face-up contract available to that player, so the printed contract-icon fallback applies. It is unnecessary for every contract token to be in a player's possession: the remaining reserved token is unacquired but legally unavailable to this player. It stays set aside. This ruling does not determine Shaddam's own choice if he later receives a contract icon with public offers empty.

key_corrections.classification: Required explicit versioned availability qualification; original all-taken case remains true
key_corrections.original_expected_answer: Take one of two face-up into supply then refill face up from bank; if all taken gain 2 Solari (also without module). Harvest: visit Maker and gain specified total spice that turn including other sources. Immediate upon taking. Acquire The Spice Must Flow on next acquiring that card.
key_corrections.problem: The original accurately repeats the p16 all-taken sufficient case but presents no-face-up-availability too narrowly. Printed p20 and the Board Space Guide use none left/none remaining. With Shaddam, global ownership and another human's legal availability diverge. Do not silently turn the original condition into an if-and-only-if rule. Preserve every contract-type part of this answer.
key_corrections.proposed_complete_expected_answer: With CHOAM, take one of the available face-up contracts on the board into your supply, then replace it face up from the bank if a bank contract remains. The printed icon guide gives 2 Solari if there are none left; this does not require every contract token in the game to have been acquired. In particular, another human with no public contract available gains 2 Solari even if Shaddam's set-aside Sardaukar contracts remain unacquired, and cannot take those reserved contracts. Without CHOAM the icon also gives 2 Solari. Shaddam's own reserved-contract option follows Sardaukar Commander and the FAQ. A Harvest contract completes by sending an Agent to a Maker space and gaining the specified total spice during that turn, including other sources. Immediate completes as soon as taken. Acquire The Spice Must Flow completes when that card is next acquired.
key_corrections.scope_note: No claim is added that Shaddam must take 2 Solari, or may freely choose 2 Solari instead of an available reserved contract, when his public offers are empty.

key_corrections.classification: Required explicit versioned availability qualification; retain both complete space effects
key_corrections.original_expected_answer: Accept Contract: Spice Trade, draw card plus contract or 2 Solari, no automatic Faction Influence. Dutiful Service: Emperor, one Emperor Influence plus contract or 2 Solari. Contract fallback if module off or all contracts taken.
key_corrections.problem: All contracts taken is a sufficient fallback condition, but it is not the sole availability formulation printed in the sources. The Board Space Guide says none remaining. Another human's unavailable Shaddam reserve must not disable that human's fallback.
key_corrections.proposed_complete_expected_answer: Accept Contract uses the Spice Trade Agent icon: draw one card and resolve a contract icon; it does not automatically gain Faction Influence. Dutiful Service uses the Emperor Agent icon: gain one Emperor Influence and resolve a contract icon. Without CHOAM each contract icon gives 2 Solari. With CHOAM, take an available public face-up contract into your supply and refill from the bank if possible; the icon gives 2 Solari if no such contract remains. For another human, Shaddam's unacquired set-aside Sardaukar contracts are unavailable and do not prevent this fallback when the public supply is empty. Shaddam's reserved-contract acquisition option remains governed by his Leader and the FAQ.
key_corrections.scope_note: Preserves both access icons, the draw, the Emperor gain, no automatic non-Faction gain, both module states and fallback; makes no new hard ruling about Shaddam's own empty-public alternatives.

main16_take.finding: Ordinary taking is from the two public face-up offers into supply, with refill from bank. The p16 fallback is worded as all contracts having been taken by players.

main20_contract.finding: Contract icon means gain 2 Solari without CHOAM; with CHOAM take a face-up contract or, if there are none left, gain 2 Solari. This is an availability formulation, not a global-ownership requirement.

leader_reserved.finding: Set aside both Sardaukar contracts. Only you can acquire them during the game. Independently visually verified against the supplied unannotated original Leader image.

faq_shaddam.finding: Sardaukar Commander gives the option to acquire a set-aside Sardaukar contract in place of one of the generally available contracts. Shaddam does not begin with them in his possession. Signet restriction applies only to the triggered turn.

main16_setup.finding: Generic 20-contract shuffle, two public face-up offers and 18 in bank; four additional Intrigue and Imperium cards; Shaddam optional. His printed Leader instruction modifies the generic contract setup.

main16_complete.finding: Board-space, Harvest, Immediate and Acquire The Spice Must Flow completion; held-at-placement timing; rewards and face-down completed token left in supply.

faq_contracts.finding: Completion mandatory, same-space contracts complete together, and effects can be ordered with board-space and Agent-box effects.

supp_accept.finding: Accept Contract: Spice Trade access, draw a card, take a contract with CHOAM; if none remaining or module absent gain 2 Solari instead.

supp_dutiful.finding: Dutiful Service: Emperor access and one Emperor Influence, plus take a contract with CHOAM; if none remaining or module absent gain 2 Solari instead.

supp_rival.finding: Rivals never take contracts and gain 2 Solari instead of each contract Conflict reward even with CHOAM.

main_bank.finding: Ordinary resource gains come from the common bank.

main_precedence.finding: Leader left ability is used as described; cards of any type can override the normal rules.
